wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-: This page shows revisions that have been automatically flagged for review. Each row shows one flag, with a button for each verdict beside it. If the revision does not match the flag, mark it as a false positive. If the flag is correct but nothing more needs to be done, mark the revision as needing no further action. Either verdict marks the revision as handled, as does suppressing the text of a revision that does need action.
